summary: 낙동강 하구 삼각주와 금강 하구 등지에 사는 것으로 기록된 오리로, 몸 크기는 혹부리오리와 비슷하다. 부산 부근 낙동강 하류에서 한 마리가 잡힌 것을 마지막으로 멸종한 것으로 보고 있다.

sexes.male: 이마에서 뒷목 중간까지 어두운 녹색 금속광택이 도는 검은색이고, 뒷머리와 뒷목 깃이 댕기처럼 늘어지며 그 아래는 희다. 윗가슴과 어깨깃은 암녹색, 배는 회색, 아래꽁지덮깃 부근은 오렌지색이며, 등은 적갈색을 띤 회색이다.
sexes.female: 몸은 갈색이고 흰 머리에 검은 댕기와 검은 눈테가 있다.

art.subject: Crested Shelduck (Tadorna cristata), adult male, as last recorded at Korean river mouths in winter: forehead, crown, nape and a broad stripe down the hindneck black glossed dark green, the elongated nape feathers forming a long drooping crest; face, cheeks and foreneck pale grey-white below the black cap; upper breast and scapulars blackish with a dark green gloss; belly and flanks dark grey, finely vermiculated; back grey tinged rufous; undertail coverts orange-brown; upper and under wing coverts white, forming a large white patch on the closed wing; speculum glossy green; tertials chestnut on the outer web; primaries and tail black. Short, nearly straight pinkish bill; yellowish legs.
art.pose: standing on a riverbank, side view
art.scene: Nakdong river estuary in winter: wide sandbars, mudflats and dry reeds under a pale sky; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view standing: black cap glossed dark green from the forehead to mid-hindneck ending in a long drooping crest, pale grey-white face and foreneck, blackish-green upper breast, dark grey finely vermiculated belly and flanks, large white wing patch, green speculum, pinkish bill, yellowish legs

adult female, side view standing: black cap and long drooping crest, white face with a white spectacle around the eye edged below by a dark band running back towards the nape, dark brown body finely vermiculated white, large white wing patch, chestnut tertials, yellowish legs
art.build: Large, goose-like shelduck, about 64cm, about the size of a Common Shelduck and a little larger than a Mallard, with an upright stance on fairly long legs. Rounded head with a long, drooping crest of nape feathers in both sexes; medium-length neck. Bill short and broad, almost straight along the culmen, shorter than the head. Legs set near the middle of the body, feet webbed. At rest the white wing coverts form a large white patch along the side. Tail short, black and slightly graduated. In flight the broad white forewing contrasts with black flight feathers and a green speculum.
art.basis: 형태: 국내외 종 설명 교차 확인(출처 목록) · tools/ART_RULES.md
avoid: Do not paint a white body with a chestnut breast-band and a red bill knob — that is Common Shelduck (Tadorna tadorna).
Do not paint an orange-chestnut body with a pale head — that is Ruddy Shelduck (Tadorna ferruginea).
Do not paint the crest erect or short; it is a long tuft of nape feathers hanging down the back of the neck.
Do not give the female a black eye-ring on a plain white face; the eye sits in a white spectacle bordered below by a dark band.
marks: male: black cap to mid-hindneck glossed dark green
female: white face with a white spectacle around the eye, edged below by a dark band
male: blackish-green upper breast, grey belly
